# Linear Projects Viewer

> A minimal web app that displays Linear projects and issues as a collapsible tree with a CLI aesthetic.

## Overview

- Syncs with Linear via OAuth
- Supports multiple workspaces
- Displays projects and issues in a tree structure with box-drawing characters

## Navigation

- **Workspace selector**: `workspace: {name}` in nav bar - click to switch
- **Team filter**: `team: {name}` in nav bar - filter issues by team
- **Expand/collapse**: Click task row or ▶/▼ arrow
- **Project collapse**: Click project header
- **Reset**: Click "reset" to restore default view state

## Status Indicators

- ○ (todo) - `data-status="todo"` - Ready to start (planned for soon)
- ◌ (backlog) - `data-status="backlog"` - In the queue (not coming soon)
- ◐ (in-progress) - `data-status="in-progress"` - In progress
- ✓ (done) - `data-status="done"` - Completed

## DOM Structure

### Landmarks
- `main` - main content area
- `[role="region"][aria-label="In Progress Tasks"]` - in-progress section
- `[role="region"][aria-label="Projects"]` - projects section

### Node Container Structure
Issues are wrapped in nested `.node` containers:
```
.node[data-id="{id}"]           - node container
  .line[data-id="{id}"]         - task row (clickable)
  .details[data-details-for]    - details panel (hidden by default)
    .detail-toggle[data-toggle="details"] - "Details ▶" toggle
    .detail-content[data-content="details"] - description + metadata (hidden)
    .detail-toggle[data-toggle="prompts"]  - "Prompts ▶" toggle (auth only)
    .detail-content[data-content="prompts"] - prompt buttons (hidden)
    .detail-link                - "View in Linear →" link
  .children                     - container for nested child nodes
    .node[data-id="{child-id}"] - child node (same structure)
```

### Detail Section Toggles
When a task is expanded, its details contain toggleable sections:
- **Details ▶**: Description and metadata (assignee, dates, labels)
- **Prompts ▶**: Prompt buttons and AI features (authenticated users only)
- **View in Linear →**: Navigation link (always visible)

Toggle behavior:
- Both sections start collapsed (▶ arrow)
- Click toggle to expand (▼ arrow) and show content
- Toggle state is per-issue and does not persist across page loads
- Same task in different sections (In Progress vs Project) has independent toggles

### Task Selectors
Both In Progress and Projects sections use the same nested structure:
- `.node[data-id="{id}"]` - node container wrapping line, details, and children
- `.node > .line` - task row element within a node
- `.node > .details` - details panel (sibling of .line within same node)
- `.node > .children` - container for nested child nodes
- `[data-id="{linear-issue-id}"]` - task by Linear issue ID (on both .node and .line)
- `[data-identifier="{LIN-123}"]` - task by Linear identifier (on .line element)
- `[data-status="todo|in-progress|done"]` - filter by status
- `[data-section="in-progress|project"]` - scope to section (expand state is independent per section)
- `[data-parent="{id}"]` - parent ID (on .line element)
- `[data-depth="{n}"]` - nesting level (0 = top-level, on .line element)
- `.expandable` - tasks that can be clicked to expand
- `.in-progress-project` - project name badge shown in brackets for In Progress items

### Traversing the Tree
- Find node by ID: `.node[data-id="{id}"]`
- Find node's details: `.node[data-id="{id}"] > .details`
- Find node's direct children: `.node[data-id="{id}"] > .children > .node`
- Find all descendants: `.node[data-id="{id}"] .node`

### Project Selectors
- `.project[data-id="{project-id}"]` - project container
- `.project-header` - clickable project header
- `[data-completed-for="{project-id}"]` - completed tasks section
- `[data-action="create-task"]` - "Add +" link (project level, authenticated only)

### Search Selectors
- `.search-toggle` - opens/closes search panel (in nav bar)
- `#search-panel` - search input panel (below nav bar)
- `#search-input` - text input for keyword search
- `.search-clear` / `#search-clear` - clears search and restores full view
- `#search-no-results` - "no matching issues" message (shown when search has zero results)
- `[data-search-text]` - lowercased searchable content on each `.line` (title, description, assignee, ID, labels)

### Navigation Selectors
- `#workspace-toggle` - workspace dropdown button
- `#team-toggle` - team dropdown button
- `#workspace-options` - workspace dropdown panel
- `#team-options` - team dropdown panel
- `[data-team="{id}"]` - team filter option (use "all" for all teams)

### Footer Selectors
- `.page-footer` - footer container
- `.footer-actions` - container for action links (authenticated pages only)
- `.footer-action` - action link (reset, audit)
- `.reset-view` - reset button (in footer)
- `.footer-deploy` - deploy information container
- `.footer-link` - link within deploy info (commit hash or GitHub repo)
- `.footer-ai-status` - AI connection status indicator
- `.footer-ai-status.free` - free tier status (yellow, shows "ai: ● free (N/5)")
- `[data-ai-source]` - AI source attribute on footer status (`oauth`, `env`, `free`)

### Interactive Elements
- `.toggle` - expand/collapse arrow for child tasks (▶/▼)
- `.detail-toggle` - expand/collapse toggle for detail sections (Details ▶ / Prompts ▶)
- `.detail-toggle[data-toggle="details"]` - Details section toggle
- `.detail-toggle[data-toggle="prompts"]` - Prompts section toggle
- `.detail-content[data-content="details"]` - Details section content (hidden by default)
- `.detail-content[data-content="prompts"]` - Prompts section content (hidden by default)
- `.in-progress-header` - collapsible section header

## Workflow Labels

Tasks use 2 workflow labels:

**`blocked`** - Work stuck on external dependency
- Use when work cannot continue due to dependency, decision, or missing info
- Analyze blockers and find resolution paths
- Remove when blocker is resolved

**`bug`** - Investigating unexpected behavior
- Use when investigating unexpected behavior
- Document reproduction steps and hypotheses
- Remove when bug is fixed

### Label Rules

1. **Work issues can coexist**: `blocked` and `bug` can apply to the same task
2. **Remove when done**: Remove labels when their purpose is complete

### Typical Flow

1. New task arrives → it is Ready once it's in a backlog/unstarted state
2. Work begins → set status to "In Progress"
3. If blocked → add `blocked` label
4. If bug found → add `bug` label
5. Work complete → set status to "Done"

### Readiness Checks

- `blocked`: "Can work resume based on this analysis?"
- `bug`: "Could someone implement a fix based on this?"

**DOM Selectors:**
- `.label-prompt[data-issue-id][data-label]` - clickable label that generates a prompt
- `.prompt-container[data-prompt-for="{id}"]` - container for generated prompt
- `.prompt-text` - the prompt text (inside container)
- `.prompt-copy` - copy button (inside container)

### Available Prompt Templates (14 total)

**Default Prompts** (shown for every issue, including completed/canceled):
- `look-into` - look into: Quick overview and context for any task
- `research` - research: Investigate unknowns and gather information
- `plan` - plan: Step-by-step implementation with test coverage
- `implementation` - implement: Active coding phase guidance

**More Prompts** (behind "more" toggle):
- `blocked` - blocked: Analyze and resolve blockers
- `bug` - bug: Find root cause and potential fixes
- `code-review` - code review: Review code for correctness, tests, and quality
- `triage` - triage: Review and update metadata (labels, priority)
- `breakdown` - breakdown: Break large tasks into actionable subtasks
- `scoping` - scoping: Define boundaries and success criteria
- `design` - design: Evaluate approaches and recommend architecture
- `spike` - spike: Time-boxed exploration for proof-of-concept
- `context` - context: Synthesize current state when joining mid-task
- `review` - review: Verify implementation before merge
- `retro` - retro: Retrospective look-back (or in-flight reorient) — reconstruct what happened, assess downstream effects/risks, surface lessons; presents findings without writing back

### More Prompts Inline
Access additional prompt templates from any issue, regardless of its labels or state.
A "more" link appears after visible prompts; clicking reveals all remaining prompts inline.
Prompts (including `retro`) are available on completed/canceled issues too.

**DOM Selectors:**
- `.more-toggle[data-issue-id]` - "more" link (appears after visible prompts)
- `[data-more-for="{id}"]` - hidden span containing additional prompt links

**Usage:**
1. Expand any issue with promptable labels
2. Click "more" link at end of labels row
3. Additional prompts appear inline (same comma-separated format)
4. Click any prompt to load it into the prompt container

### AI Recommendation Selectors
- `.suggest-btn` - AI suggest button (in Prompts section, requires OpenRouter)
- `.recommend-container[data-recommend-for="{id}"]` - recommendation result container
- `.recommend-reasoning` - AI reasoning text
- `.recommend-prompt` - generated prompt text
- `.free-tier-info` / `[data-testid="free-tier-info"]` - free tier usage info below recommendation
- `.free-tier-limit-reached` - error message when daily limit exceeded
- `[data-free-tier-status]` - free tier status on settings page
- `[data-free-tier-usage]` - free tier usage display on settings page

## Pipeline Floor View

The Pipeline page (`/workspace/{urlKey}/pipeline`) shows a control-panel view of active tasks, dispatch loops, and agent state. Requires the `pipeline` feature flag.

### Pipeline Layout
- **Queue rail** (left): Tasks ready to start, ordered by priority
- **Active grid** (center): Tasks with open loops (queued/running/waiting), shown as cards
- **Activity rail** (right): Recently completed/errored loops

### Pipeline DOM Structure
```
main.pipeline-page[data-url-key]       - page container
  .pipeline-header                      - header with title and fetch timestamp
    #pipeline-fetched-at                - last fetch time
  .pipeline-floor                       - three-column layout
    .pipeline-rail.pipeline-queue       - queue rail
      #pipeline-queue-list              - queue entries (ol)
      #pipeline-queue-empty             - empty state
    .pipeline-grid-wrap                 - active grid wrapper
      #pipeline-grid                    - grid of active task cells
      #pipeline-grid-empty              - empty state
    .pipeline-rail.pipeline-activity    - activity rail
      #pipeline-activity-list           - activity entries (ul)
      #pipeline-activity-empty          - empty state
  #pipeline-overlay                     - detail overlay (hidden by default)
```

### Pipeline Cell Selectors
- `.pipeline-cell[data-identifier]` - task card in the grid
- `.pipeline-cell[data-agent-state="running|waiting|error"]` - agent state tint
- `.cell-parent-tag[data-parent-id]` - parent link button
- `.cell-loops.health-green|health-amber|health-red` - loop count with health color
- `.queue-entry[data-identifier]` - queue rail entry

### Pipeline Overlay Selectors
- `.overlay-content.overlay-leaf` - leaf task detail panel
- `.overlay-content.overlay-parent` - parent task container panel
- `.overlay-recommend` - "generate next prompt" button
- `.overlay-dispatch` - "dispatch to agent" button
- `.overlay-close` - close button

### Pipeline Data
- `window.__PIPELINE_DATA__` - initial snapshot embedded by server
  - `.snapshot.active` - active tasks array
  - `.snapshot.queue` - queue tasks array
  - `.snapshot.recent` - recent loop activity array
  - `.urlKey` - workspace URL key
  - `.featureFlags` - feature flag state

### Pipeline Polling
- Grid polls `/workspace/{urlKey}/api/pipeline/state` every 5s (visibility-gated)
- Overlay polls `/workspace/{urlKey}/api/pipeline/task/{identifier}` every 2s
- Health colors: green (≤3 loops), amber (≤6), red (>6)

### Dispatched Sessions (Swipe)
- `GET /workspace/{urlKey}/api/sessions/{identifier}` → `{ sessions: [...] }` (newest-first dispatch loops for one issue, with feedback)
- Swipe card "Dispatched Sessions [N]" accordion (`data-accordion="sessions"`); shown only when the `dispatch` feature flag is on. `[N]` count is baked into the card server-side.

## Common Workflows

1. **Find in-progress tasks**: Look in "In Progress" section at top (displays as tree with subtasks)
2. **Drill into project**: Click project header to expand, click task to see details
3. **Expand subtasks**: Click parent task or ▶ arrow to show child tasks (works in both sections)
4. **Filter by team**: Use team selector in nav bar
5. **Search for issues**: Click "search" in nav bar (or press "/"), type keywords to filter issues across all sections
6. **Open in Linear**: Expand task, click "View in Linear →" link
7. **View task details**: Expand task, click "Details ▶" to show description and metadata
8. **Generate prompt for task**: Expand task, click "Prompts ▶" to reveal prompt buttons, click a prompt button, copy the generated prompt
9. **Get AI recommendation**: Expand task, click "Prompts ▶", click "AI suggest" button (free tier: 5/day per workspace)

## Limitations

- Read-only view (no editing tasks)
- Logout requires re-authentication via Linear OAuth
- Expand/collapse state persists in localStorage (reset restores defaults)
- Team filter selection persists in localStorage across sessions
- Landing page shows static demo data for unauthenticated users
